lines.zh: 我的腿部液压一步一响
lines.en: My leg hydraulics sound at each step.

lines.zh: 我沿着边界走，路线很直
lines.en: I walk the boundary in a straight line.
Paint is missing in a few spots.
I measure height before each step.
My hull rises and falls with each step.
I cross a stretch of rubble.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下方正的印子
lines.en: Each step leaves a square print.
My joint sleeves are polished by wear.
To turn, I bank my chassis.
My cadence is fixed and never breaks.
I move faster than I look.
In the open I slow down.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖试探松软的地面
lines.en: I test soft ground with a toe.

lines.zh: 后面的地面被我压实了
lines.en: The ground behind me is packed flat.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，机身微微起伏
lines.en: I stop and my chassis idles.
My sensors sweep in rings.

lines.zh: 我在等处决名单上的名字
lines.en: I wait for a name on the list.
My designation is PMS06.

lines.zh: 机身内部有节奏地嗡响
lines.en: A steady hum inside my hull.
My heat sink is hot enough to cook on.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿收起来省电
lines.en: I tuck one leg in to save power.
The air here is clean.

lines.zh: 我的镜头里没有动的东西
lines.en: Nothing moves in my lens.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，随即收回来
lines.en: I lift a hand, then draw it back.
I listen to distant machinery.
Waiting is what I do best.
My lens zooms in. It's you.

lines.zh: 你的体形在我的档案外
lines.en: Your build isn't in my archive.
I turn my chassis toward you.
You don't even have a number.
I raise an arm only to measure.
Your pulse rate is high.
I tip my hull down to see you.
I turn my frame toward you.
Ten paces between us.
This distance is suitable.
A plate is knocked off.
I step back and re-brace.
Something rattles inside.
Sparks fall across my foot.
Damage doesn't affect locomotion.
My lens flickers once.
Two bolts worked loose.

lines.zh: 我重新计算了你的威胁
lines.en: I recalculate your threat.
You're stronger than the file says.
I adopt a different stance.
You're not the power source I need.
Hold that up and your arm will ache.
I run on power, not bread.
Scan complete. Useless.

lines.zh: 我不会为这个改变路线
lines.en: I won't change course for that.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我就要重新测距
lines.en: Approach and I'll re-range you.
Set it down and back away slowly.
This is not a negotiation.
I looked once. That's courtesy.
Don't tease a mech with food.
You hit me. I stand like a post.

lines.zh: 我机身的重量压在你肩上
lines.en: My hull's weight bears on your shoulder.
You're shoved off and lose your step.
That impact is in my log.
I angle aside to give you half a step.
The metal ring drags on.
One leg steps back to brace.
Don't touch my vent.
Step back and we carry on.
I dislike being pushed.

lines.zh: 我需要一个稳定的坐标
lines.en: I need one stable coordinate.
I can record your position.
I take the left flank.
I've memorized your stride.

lines.zh: 我可以把速度调到你的一半
lines.en: I can run at half your speed.
Walk beside me; the wind drops.
I can't generate that sort of line.
But my route can change.

lines.zh: 这条巡逻线，我们分着走
lines.en: We'll split this patrol line.
When it's over, come back to me.
I nudge it straight with a toe.
I bend, and a hydraulic hisses.
This metal is recoverable.
The part number doesn't match.

lines.zh: 有用的进机腹，没用的丢下
lines.en: Useful goes in; the rest stays.
You dropped it; I have it.
My grip is steadier than yours.
Weight nominal. Carrying it.

lines.zh: 地上还有几块，我一并收
lines.en: More on the ground. Taking all.
Inventory logged. We can move.
Target confirmed. Closing.
One of my hands comes up.

lines.zh: 你进入了我的作业区域
lines.en: You've entered my work area.
Range measured, angle set.
I don't need to accelerate.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比你的武器长
lines.en: My arm outranges your weapon.
You retreat; I keep the gap.

lines.zh: 不要试着绕后，我转得快
lines.en: Don't flank me. I turn fast.
I've left margin this round.
You have one chance to withdraw.
Counting three, then two.
One. Executing now.
Chassis braced. Motion begins.
No feelings. Only steps.
The lock doesn't release itself.
You're in the process now.
My legs press nearer, joint by joint.
You back to a wall. No road there.
My lens follows you without letup.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏了，我看见了
lines.en: Your balance is off. I saw.

lines.zh: 我在算最短的打击路径
lines.en: I'm finding the shortest strike path.
You raise a hand; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我等的不是机会，是距离
lines.en: I don't wait for luck, but for range.
No cover for you in this stretch.

lines.zh: 你的脚步已经乱了两次
lines.en: Two stumbles already.
I hold this rhythm.

lines.zh: 你听得见我接近的声音
lines.en: You can hear me closing.
The sound won't stop.
Two steps and you're in reach.
My arm is pre-positioned.
Calibration done. Waiting for you.
All you have left is movement.
Nothing beyond that. Nothing else.
My backhand sweeps your knees.

lines.zh: 这一拳落在你的护甲上
lines.en: This fist lands on your armour.
My hull presses in and shoves you back.
I plant a leg on your foot.
The metal clang lasts a while.
You blocked it and lost two steps.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是机身重量
lines.en: That one used my hull's weight.
Your bracer is crooked.
I raise the other hand.
Not elegant. Efficient.
You're driven into the rocks.
My metal arm falls—this ends here.
I fall from the air and land square.
PMS06, online.

lines.zh: 我是被投放的，不是自然生成
lines.en: I was deployed, not naturally spawned.
I chose where to land.

lines.zh: 机身外壳还有出厂的痕迹
lines.en: My hull still shows factory marks.
Good sightlines here.
I sweep the area and find a heading.
No squad. I move alone.
Power is still ample.
Living things nearby.
Beginning patrol.
Stay, or leave.
The heat blackens my plating.

lines.zh: 我落地时液压炸了一根
lines.en: Landing, one hydraulic bursts.

lines.zh: 水从缝隙进机身，腿很沉
lines.en: Water seeps into my chassis; the legs drag.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得滑出几格
lines.en: The blast slides me back a few blocks.
An arrow jams in my shoulder plate.
That force went straight through the hull.
Low power. Output reduced.

lines.zh: 电流从机壳一路跑到腿
lines.en: Current runs from hull down to my legs.

lines.zh: 坠进虚空，我的腿找不到地。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my legs find nothing.
